expirationDate.description: When the snapshot stops being readable: its finish time plus CYODA_SEARCH_SNAPSHOT_TTL. From then on a request for it is refused with SEARCH_JOB_NOT_FOUND. While the snapshot is RUNNING, a lower bound, its create time plus the TTL; final once it ends. cyoda-go sets it on the answers to SnapshotGetStatusRequest and SnapshotCancelRequest; the answer to the submit and an error for no snapshot leave it out.

failureReason.description: Why the snapshot failed. Present only when status is FAILED, and absent for every other status. For a failure the request itself caused, it is the same client error a direct search would answer, code first; for any other failure it names no internal detail: a server-side failure is SERVER_ERROR: internal error [ticket: <uuid>], its detail logged under the ticket, and a few known causes carry a fixed text.
